title: SideNote Comment
description: Schema for a single comment line in comments.jsonl. Each line in the file is one JSON object matching this schema. The file is stored at .obsidian/plugins/side-note/comments.jsonl inside an Obsidian vault.

id.description: Unique identifier (nanoid, 3 characters). Used for all lookups, edits, deletes, and parent references.

filePath.description: Vault-relative path to the commented file (e.g. 'notes/todo.md').

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the comment was created. Used only for display and sorting, NOT as an identifier.

type.description: Comment type. 'file' = comment on the whole file (no text anchor). 'selection' = comment on a specific text selection. Defaults to 'selection' if omitted.

parentId.description: ID of the parent comment. Present only on replies. Replies always point to the root comment (flat hierarchy, max 1 level deep).

parentTimestamp.description: Legacy field: timestamp of the parent comment. Use parentId instead for lookups.

resolved.description: Whether this comment is resolved. Resolving a root comment cascades to all its replies.

resolvedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the comment was resolved. Null if unresolved.

isOrphaned.description: True when the anchored text was deleted from the file. Only applies to selection comments.

selectedText.description: The original text that was selected when creating the comment. Empty string for file comments.

selectedTextHash.description: SHA-256 hash of selectedText for robust text anchoring. Empty string for file comments.

startLine.description: 0-based start line of the text selection. 0 for file comments.

startChar.description: 0-based start character within the start line. 0 for file comments.

endLine.description: 0-based end line of the text selection. 0 for file comments.

endChar.description: 0-based end character within the end line. 0 for file comments.

commentPath.description: Path to an optional external markdown file storing the comment body.
